entities.name: Carl Ewald von Rönne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Ewald von Rönne was a German-born Russian cavalry officer. He became General of the Cavalry in the Russian army of Peter the Great. He served in both the Great Northern War and in the Russo-Turkish War of 1710–1713. He also commanded the tsarist army in Ukraine from 1711 to 1716.

entities.name: Carl Ewald von Rönne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Ewald von Rönne was a German-born Russian cavalry officer. He became General of the Cavalry in the Russian army of Peter the Great. He served in both the Great Northern War and in the Russo-Turkish War of 1710–1713. He also commanded the tsarist army in Ukraine from 1711 to 1716.
